title: lathyrus luteus var. occidentalis
intro: Lathyrus luteus var. occidentalis, commonly known as Western sweet pea, is a flowering legume plant native to North America. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, and the health benefits of the plant include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Western sweet pea include its ability to act as a vasodilator, which can help to improve circulation and reduce blood pressure, as well as its antimicrobial properties, which can help to prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of Lathyrus luteus var. occidentalis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
